notes: Every trophy is single-player; there are no online trophies.
There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
Cheats switch off trophies and saving on the save they are used on.
One trophy may be missable: Positive Mental Attitude, whose Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1.
sources: OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements (Nov 2026)
planetgta6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements (Nov 2026), cross-checked with Exophase, PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements
PowerPyx trophy guide and GTABase trophy list, as cited by the above

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Plan for roughly 200 hours and leave the 100% cleanup for after the credits.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Work through the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once it appears after the story. Progress made earlier still counts, so chip away at stunts, races and collectibles as you play.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: OutputLag trophy list; PowerPyx via GTABase

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all add up. You need 250 here and 300 for 100%, so keep a stunt or two in mind whenever you cross the map.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit both shooting ranges and chase gold on every challenge. Steady aim beats fast trigger work; restart a challenge rather than settling for silver.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Vault jobs open late in the story through an optional mission. Bring your partner — you cannot carry every bag alone — and plan your escape before you go in, because a four-star response follows immediately.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger questlines. A few named characters have their own trophies and do not count here, so watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Track down cards around Leonida until three full sets are complete. Cards hide in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way corners, so sweep each district as you explore it.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app and scan a hundred marked spots. Fold it into your exploring: scan whenever the prompt appears instead of saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once — races, fishing, the arcade, the ranges and the rest. It pops as soon as the last new activity is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Win twenty distinct races across the race types on offer. Different events count; repeating the same one does not.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earn four stars with your partner beside you, then break out of the search area together. Bank vault jobs hand you four stars at once, so pair this with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then hit three shops in a row while the heat stays on. If the stars fade between shops the chain breaks, so keep moving and do not linger.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan traffic with the WAiNK app as you drive; each new model counts. You need a hundred here and two hundred for 100%.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.guide: Cover every region of the map, from Vice City out to the swamps and keys. Driving the highways with the map open fills the gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops naturally on the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; sell them on through your contacts. The quarter-million total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one drone race at each of the fourteen Top Fun spots. Learn one racing line per location rather than brute-forcing them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: The total is cumulative across every shop type. Big purchases — vehicles, weapons, clothes — move it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages from the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost around $160,000.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Take a car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Watch the line tension and reel in during the calm moments.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games. Pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner so each outdoor spot counts for both characters. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before that chapter ends — it never comes back.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming). Find a group of enemies, trigger it with an assault rifle, and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun. Use it on a store's locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm — find the safe code inside, open the safe and leave unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get clear of the heat. The trophy pops once you are fully out of the red zone, not just out of the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Challenges live under Progress > Challenges. Fifty earns this; seventy of eighty is the 100% bar. Many complete on their own as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It unlocks automatically as the story begins.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy can pop as Chapter 2 begins, so do not worry if it is a little late.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Both protagonists become playable here, which opens most of the free-roam list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Jewelry jobs, racing strands and several robbery tools open up around this point.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The late-story robbery options, including bank vaults, open near its end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay if anything goes sideways.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run early in Chapter 2. Character switching opens right after it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in the natural course of the plot.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play as the story reaches it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission at the airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's side strand through to its final mission. Side strands stay available after the credits.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's strand through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret Vogel's Jason-only hunting questline and take down a unique animal. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Back out, take off, and fly about a kilometre clear before the trophy pops. Save first: the police respond fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — Rhinos are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the far south-west island. Drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates alley from Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs, take the three key valuables — the luxury watch, the shotgun and the office safe — then escape. Anything left behind can be collected on a later visit.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up through ordinary play.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Find the Ocean Beach spot, order a cocktail and take in the view. A quiet one — no fighting needed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive straight out through a vehicle showroom's frontage. Pick a showroom, build speed inside if you can, and smash through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second attempt. It pops on the retry — the game notices the comeback.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Stumble into one of Leonida's stranger sights. Keep an eye out while exploring off the beaten track and it will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Score a melee drive-by takedown near the bowling alley — a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
